_meta.notes: US patient population (prevalent/annual treated) for each disease in OPPORTUNITY_UNIVERSE. For acute/infectious diseases this is annual incidence (= annual treatment population). For chronic diseases this is point prevalence. Sources listed per entry. Refresh annually — these change slowly.
sources: NCI SEER Cancer Statistics, November 2024 submission
Crohn's & Colitis Foundation, NAMI, MPN Research Foundation disease reports
CDC National Center for Health Statistics

Glioblastoma Multiforme.note: NCI SEER: ~13,500 new GBM cases/yr; median survival ~15 months → ~15-17K prevalent

Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma.note: NCI SEER 2024: ~64,500 new pancreatic cancer cases/yr; ~95% are PDAC; median survival ~12 months

ALS (SOD1-mutant).note: ALS Association 2023: ~32,000 US ALS patients. SOD1 is ~2% of familial ALS but therapy targets all progressive ALS

Carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales.note: CDC AR Threats 2022: ~900,000 CRE infections/yr in US healthcare settings

Acinetobacter baumannii MDR.note: CDC AR Threats 2022: ~8,500 MDR A. baumannii infections/yr; ~700 attributable deaths

Spinal Muscular Atrophy Type 2.note: Cure SMA: ~10,000-14,000 US SMA patients (all types); Type 2 ~65% of treated burden → ~9,000

HER2-low Breast Cancer.note: NCI SEER: ~315,000 new BC/yr; HER2-low defined as IHC 1+ or 2+/ISH-negative → ~55-60% → ~185,000 new HER2-low cases/yr

KRAS G12C NSCLC.note: NSCLC incidence ~200,000/yr; KRAS G12C ~13% → ~26,000 new/yr; 2-yr treatment window → ~52,000 prevalent

Huntington Disease.note: HDSA 2022: ~30,000 symptomatic US HD patients; ~200,000 at 50% genetic risk

Friedreich Ataxia.note: NORD / FARA: ~1 in 50,000 US prevalence → ~6,600; broader estimates 15,000 including undiagnosed

C. difficile Infection.note: CDC 2021: ~462,000 CDI cases/yr in US; ~30,000 deaths; recurrence rate ~20%

MRSA Skin Infections.note: CDC AR Threats 2022: ~119,000 invasive MRSA + ~750,000 community SSTI/yr; outpatient SSTI dominates

Type 1 Diabetes (CGM/automated insulin).note: ADA 2023: ~1.9M US T1D patients; distinct from T2D (~37M). CGM penetration ~50% and rising

Alzheimer Disease (early/MCI).note: Alzheimer's Association Facts & Figures 2023: 6.7M Americans 65+ with Alzheimer's/dementia

Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension.note: AHA/WHO: PAH prevalence ~15-52/million → ~200,000 US; distinct from broader PH (~3M)

Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy.note: Parent Project MD / CDC: ~20,000-23,000 US DMD patients; almost exclusively male

Myelofibrosis JAK-resistant.note: MPN Research Foundation: ~21,000 US MF patients total; JAK-resistant subset ~8,000-10,000 (key commercial target)

Geographic Atrophy (dry AMD).note: AMD Alliance / Apellis Pharma: ~8M US AMD patients; GA (advanced dry AMD) ~1-1.5M requiring treatment

Sickle Cell Disease (gene therapy).note: CDC: ~100,000 Americans with SCD; gene therapy target is severe SCD (HbSS) ~75,000

RSV in elderly/immunocompromised.note: CDC: ~177,000 RSV hospitalizations + ~6-10K deaths in adults 65+/yr; ~1.5M symptomatic cases annually

Sepsis (AI early detection).note: CDC: ~1.7M sepsis cases/yr in US hospitals; ~270,000 deaths. AI detection targets all hospitalized sepsis

NASH/MASH.note: Clin Liver Dis 2021 / Madrigal data: ~16M US NASH; clinically significant (F2-F4 fibrosis, drug-eligible) ~3M

Prostate Cancer (PSMA-targeted).note: NCI SEER: ~3.1M prostate cancer survivors; mCRPC (PSMA-targeted opportunity) ~300,000-400,000

Bipolar Depression.note: NAMI 2023: ~5.7M US adults with bipolar disorder; bipolar depression (depressive phase) ~4M at any time

Rare Pediatric Epilepsy (SCN1A).note: Dravet Syndrome Foundation: ~20,000-25,000 US Dravet/SCN1A patients; broader drug-resistant pediatric epilepsy ~50,000
